authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: The full phal-phul expression contains fruit plus flower: CDIAL 9051 gives Nepali/Hindi phal fruit and 9092 Nepali phul, Hindi phūl flower. Two ordered component-family edges retain both parts of the survey response meaning fruit collectively, with source spacing, vowel length and reduced first vowel preserved. This does not assign the whole response to the fruit root alone or claim an inherited Sanskrit compound; local Indo-Aryan transmission remains open. Exact response: pʰalpʰul.
